requirement.statement: Cell and terminal organ diagnostic observability SHALL use the unified DataGraph computed-node runtime contract and SHALL preserve diagnostic summary values, graph lifecycle, and trace behavior.

case.given: diagnostic signal nodes are mounted in a DataGraph upgraded to 1.0.1
case.when: their computed summary is read after signals are updated
case.then: the computed callback SHALL read dependencies through runtime.graph.get and SHALL NOT use the removed ctx.get callback API
the summary SHALL report the current tool, retry, compaction, turn, and model values

case.given: a terminal observable graph owns a simple computed signal
case.when: the signal is read with debug middleware enabled
case.then: the computation SHALL succeed through the unified runtime contract without breaking graph disposal or tracing
